title: Integrated bioinformatic and machine learning analysis identifies MCM7 and ADAM17 as potential biomarkers for early stage gastric cancer.
summary: Four GEO cohorts with 434 tumors and 100 controls were screened by LASSO, SVM-RFE and random forest; MCM7/ADAM17 were among selected gastric-cancer markers and an SVM classifier was externally assessed with TCGA/HPA. Retrospective transcriptomic associations, not clinical biomarker validation.
